text:
If you've still got evening plans on the water or the porch, don't put them away yet, but keep the rain jacket handy a little longer. Those scattered showers are sticking around before wrapping up around 11, then patchy fog settles in overnight with lows near 60. The lake's calm, light west winds under 10 knots easing southwest, waves a foot or less, water still a comfortable 73, so a late paddle or a walk along the waterfront before the fog thickens is your best bet, just don't expect much sun for it.

Tomorrow trades showers for clouds. Patchy morning fog burns off into a mostly cloudy, seasonable day, high near 79, and the models are only a few degrees apart on that, so confidence is decent. Winds go light and variable, swinging northwest by afternoon, keeping the lake gentle again. Good air quality returns too. Call it: dry enough for outdoor plans tomorrow, just don't count on much sunshine to go with them.

Mostly sunny and pleasant with a high near 81, the pick of the week so far.

The week's wettest day, showers and thunderstorms likely most of the day with a high near 81.
Lingering shower chances continue as temps cool to near 77, not a washout but keep an eye on the sky.
Sunshine returns and it looks refreshingly seasonable with a high near 77.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST: Saturday starts bright and warm with mostly sunny skies and highs near 82°. A complex weather pattern develops late Saturday as a dip in the jet stream deepens over the Great Lakes while a low-pressure system tracks off the New England coast. Isolated showers (20% chance) develop late Saturday evening, turning into widespread rain overnight (45% chance). Sunday will bring the week’s most active weather, with widespread showers and thunderstorms (90% chance) producing periods of rain and localized downpours as high temperatures reach the lower 80s. Lingering mountain showers continue Monday (40% chance) as temperatures cool into the upper 70s under mostly cloudy skies. Refreshing, seasonable weather returns Tuesday (High 75°) and Wednesday (High 79°) with mostly sunny skies.
